map.根据灾害场景与建筑条件，生成消防救援路线规划方案与注意事项: Generate a fire-rescue route plan and precautions from the disaster scenario and building conditions.
map.救援路线按场景（建筑/高层/地下/工业/化学/交通）与层数、出入口数、消防电梯、: The rescue route is selected by scenario (building/high-rise/underground/industrial/chemical/traffic) combined with floors, number of entrances, fire elevator, road width and number of vehicles: the main attack route goes via the main entrance → stairwell/fire elevator, with backup and evacuation routes plus safety tips.
map.1. 进攻路线与疏散路线分离，避免交叉干扰: 1. Keep attack routes separate from evacuation routes to avoid cross-interference
map.2. 主攻方向选择烟雾扩散方向的下风侧: 2. Choose the downwind side of the smoke-spread direction as the main attack direction
map.3. 优先利用消防电梯和疏散楼梯进行兵力投送: 3. Prioritize fire elevators and evacuation stairwells for deploying forces
map.4. 预留备用通道，确保撤退路线畅通: 4. Reserve a backup passage and keep the withdrawal route clear
map.高层：分层布控，竖向管井封堵，利用避难层中转: High-rise: staged control, seal vertical shafts, use refuge floors for transfer
map.地下：正压送风排烟，照明引导，防止方向迷失: Underground: positive-pressure ventilation, lighting guidance, prevent disorientation
map.化工：上风向部署，划定警戒区，准备洗消通道: Chemical: deploy upwind, set up a cordon, prepare a decontamination corridor
map.本工具提供救援路线规划参考要点，实际作战部署须由现场指挥员根据实时态势决定。: This tool provides reference key points for rescue-route planning; the actual operational deployment must be decided by the on-scene commander according to the real-time situation.
map.📚 深度解析：建筑火灾救援路线规划: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Building Fire Rescue Route Planning
map.火场指挥中按建筑结构、出入口与消防电梯位置规划主攻、辅助、疏散与供水路线。: In fire command, plan the main attack, backup, evacuation and water-supply routes by building structure, entrances and fire-elevator locations.
map.演练时生成作战检查清单，明确中转供水层与安全员设置。: In drills, generate an operational checklist specifying the relay water-supply floor and safety-officer setup.
map.大型综合体救援前预演多条进攻路线，避免单一通道被烟火封锁。: For large complexes, rehearse multiple attack routes in advance to avoid a single passage being blocked by smoke and fire.
map.4 辆车、2 出入口、有消防电梯的规划: Plan with 4 vehicles, 2 entrances and a fire elevator
map.按默认参数（建筑火灾、到场车辆 4、可用出入口 2、有消防电梯）：规划 4 条路: With the default parameters (building fire, 4 vehicles on scene, 2 usable entrances, fire elevator available): 4 routes are planned — main attack (main entrance → stairwell/elevator → floor below the fire floor → lay hose), backup attack (backup entrance → flank stairwell → floor above the fire floor to form a pincer), evacuation (safety exit → stairwell → outdoors) and water supply (fire engine → pump adapter → riser). The operational checklist requires a relay water-supply point every 3-5 floors and an on-scene safety officer.
map.为什么要同时规划疏散路线？: Why plan the evacuation route at the same time?
map.进攻与疏散必须分流，避免救援力量与被困人员在同一通道对冲造成拥堵或误伤；疏散路线: Attack and evacuation must be separated to avoid rescue forces and trapped occupants clashing head-on in the same passage, causing congestion or injury; the evacuation route should use a safety exit away from the fire point to ensure rapid evacuation.
map.中转供水层怎么设？: How to set the relay water-supply floor?
map.垂直供水时每 3~5 层设一个中转点接力，既保证末端压力又避免单段水带过长导致压: For vertical water supply, set a relay point every 3-5 floors to ensure end pressure while avoiding pressure decay from an over-long single hose run; this is the basic tactic for high-rise water supply.
map.根据灾害场景、建筑条件和到场力量，生成主攻/辅助/疏散/供水等多路线规划方案与作: Based on the disaster scenario, building conditions and on-scene forces, generate multi-route plans (main attack/backup/evacuation/water supply) and an operational checklist.
